candidate_origin.screen_interpretation: Post-hoc observation only: the candidate preserved all 240 previously observed OpenFake generated hits of the Community-or-Nonescape baseline while reducing FiveK original-view hits from 6/40 to 1/40.

dataset.name: ComplexDataLab/OpenFake
dataset.selection: Within the untouched fixed row window and every registered stratum, select the lowest SHA-256(revision:row_idx:label:model) values before detector inference.
dataset.license_policy: Non-commercial research only; apply the stricter CC-BY-NC-4.0 Hub metadata where the dataset card prose conflicts.
dataset.failure_rule: If the revision, any stratum, any selected asset hash, or any selected row overlaps the three observed cohorts, stop before scoring; do not replace a failed or missing stratum after scores are visible.

candidate.scope: Change only the evidentiary availability of a Community limited-threshold hit; Nonescape and every other product channel remain unchanged.
candidate.original_input_rule: Nonescape(original) >= registered high threshold OR (Community(original) >= registered limited threshold AND Community(internal JPEG-85) >= the same threshold)
candidate.jpeg85_input_rule: Nonescape(JPEG-85 input) >= registered high threshold OR (Community(JPEG-85 input) >= registered limited threshold AND Community(second JPEG-85 re-encode) >= the same threshold)
candidate.baseline_original: Community(original) OR Nonescape(original) at the same registered thresholds
candidate.baseline_jpeg85: Community(JPEG-85 input) OR Nonescape(JPEG-85 input) at the same registered thresholds
candidate.jpeg_reencode: Use the existing score_openfake_pixel_detector Pillow JPEG quality=85 path once or twice; dimensions are preserved and metadata is not used.

decision.on_recall_gate_pass: Eligible only for the separately frozen RAISE camera-native real-benefit gate and a latency/RSS measurement; not eligible for runtime deployment.
decision.on_recall_gate_fail: Reject the two-view Community stability candidate without changing the rule, threshold, JPEG quality, or row window.

limitations: OpenFake exact training exposure for both detectors remains unknown
the untouched window contains cached web assets rather than camera-native RAW controls
a logical subset can lower false positives but may also lose generator-specific Community recall
passing this protocol does not demonstrate a real-photo population benefit
